workflow_rationale: This is a documentation-only task with no code changes, service dependencies, or testing requirements. Creating two standalone markdown files requires minimal overhead and no phase-based coordination.

phases.name: Create Reference Documentation
phases.description: Create the missing troubleshooting and FAQ documentation files following existing documentation patterns

subtasks.notes: Created docs/reference/ directory with .gitkeep file. Verification passed successfully.

verification.instructions: Verify docs/reference/02-troubleshooting.md exists, has proper markdown structure, includes common issues from deployment and development, and follows the pattern: Issue → Symptom → Root Cause → Fix → Prevention

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive troubleshooting reference documentation (1071 lines) covering 9 categories: Development Environment, Design System & Tokens, Build & Deployment, SDK & API Integration, Testing Issues, Component Development, Theme & Dark Mode, TypeScript Errors, and Performance Issues. Each issue follows the required pattern: Issue → Symptom → Root Cause → Fix → Prevention. Includes quick command reference, recovery commands, and contributing guidelines. Document draws from existing guides (DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md, SESSION_LEARNINGS.md, DESIGN_TOKENS_GUIDE.md, COMPONENT_CREATION_CHECKLIST.md) to provide comprehensive troubleshooting coverage.

verification.instructions: Verify docs/reference/03-faq.md exists, has proper markdown structure, includes Q&A format, and covers common developer questions about: monorepo setup, design system usage, SDK integration, theme switching, and deployment

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive FAQ reference documentation (1385 lines, 33KB) covering 35 Q&A entries organized in 8 categories: Getting Started, Monorepo & Development, Design System & Components, SDK & API Integration, Theme & Styling, Testing & Quality, Build & Deployment, and Architecture & Patterns. Includes all required topics (monorepo setup, design system usage, SDK integration, theme switching, deployment) and specific FAQs as noted in the plan. Follows markdown patterns from DESIGN_TOKENS_GUIDE.md and COMPONENT_CREATION_CHECKLIST.md. Each answer provides clear, actionable guidance with code examples.

subtasks.description: Verify documentation completeness and markdown validity

verification.command: test -f docs/reference/02-troubleshooting.md && test -f docs/reference/03-faq.md && echo 'Both files exist: OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.notes: Documentation verification completed successfully. Both docs/reference/02-troubleshooting.md (1071 lines, 25KB) and docs/reference/03-faq.md (1385 lines, 33KB) exist with proper markdown structure. Verified: (1) Files exist at correct paths, (2) Markdown syntax is valid with 132 and 106 properly balanced code blocks respectively, (3) Proper heading hierarchy (# → ## → ###), (4) Complete content with contributing sections, (5) Comprehensive coverage as noted in previous subtasks.

acceptance_criteria: Content is accurate and helpful for developers
verification_strategy.reasoning: Trivial risk - documentation-only change with no functional code modifications. Manual review of content quality is sufficient.

checks: Documentation files exist at correct paths

qa_signoff.notes: All acceptance criteria met. Documentation is comprehensive (2,456 lines, 64KB), well-structured, and follows existing patterns. No issues found.
